harness: probe service (tools/stallfloor/probe.py): frozen kernel families, every thread of every launch judged against a host-computed checksum
what: a set of producers under TWO predicates on ONE write barrier (kind ord with pguard), the chain of an attention kernel with P0 CHANGING from pair to pair inside one pass: another bit of the iteration counter's hash for every pair (single pairs nullified for the whole warp in a pattern that changes every iteration), P0 rewritten by ISETP.GE.AND right behind each pair's last load, 13 cycles in front of the next pair; the 17-set with the second predicate a counter bit | true | false, warm and cold lines, its 9-suffix, a 5-set; each with its positive control (the reader's wait bit moved behind the reader's instructions); and, last, two requests with the text of probe.py 28's first build (the ISETP one cycle behind the shift of its source register: not right by construction) and a third host model, p0old = every such ISETP read the source's old content - they show why ten requests of `_b55` are void

conditions.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
